summary: Erasca, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to narrow the timeline for its Phase 1 monotherapy data readout for ERAS-0015 from first half 2026 to no later than mid-May 2026. No special situation event — no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, shareholder vote, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine clinical-trial update under Item 8.01 and carries no deal terms or corporate-action mechanics.
